tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Always paired with the dot grid (dot color: dot). Never use white as a page background.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: 1px dots of the 22px background grid on ground. Also the hairline between rows in lists and ledgers.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Image plates behind screenshot collages, with an 18px dot grid in dot-strong.

tokens.name: dot-strong
tokens.usage: Dots of the 18px grid on plate only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: work cards, approach cards, testimonial cards, principle cards. Always with a 1px ink border.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Spec panels and definition lists (Role / Stack / Links).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings, body text on ground or surface, card borders (1px), section rules, and the inverse (dark) panel fill.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Card descriptions longer than one line.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono captions, proof-bar labels. 7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Divider inside a card, above its links or output line.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The ONE highlight: the emphasised words in a headline, the primary button, the single highlighted card in a set, the contact strip. 5:1 on ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. 6.4:1.

tokens.name: on-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent.

tokens.name: on-accent-rule
tokens.usage: Divider inside an accent card.

tokens.name: inverse-text
tokens.usage: Text on ink panels (Rules for AI, lead testimonial, pull quotes).

tokens.name: inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink panels.

tokens.name: inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Accent words and mono labels on ink panels. Never on light grounds (fails contrast).

tokens.name: inverse-rule
tokens.usage: Row dividers on ink panels.

tokens.name: console
tokens.usage: Terminal / agent-console blocks only.

tokens.name: console-line
tokens.usage: Prompt line inside a console block.

tokens.name: console-text
tokens.usage: Text in console blocks.

tokens.name: console-success
tokens.usage: Success lines in console blocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; gap inside card text stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in every grid. Card row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter; gap below section headings.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap from hero copy to proof bar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding below a section on the homepage.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between case-study sections.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Pitch of the page dot grid.

tokens.name: grid-dot-plate
tokens.usage: Pitch of the dot grid on image plates.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width. Always centred with a 32px gutter.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, buttons, tags, plates, panels, images. The system is square-cornered by rule.

tokens.name: shadow-back
tokens.usage: Rear screenshots in a collage. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: shadow-front
tokens.usage: Front screenshot in a collage. Nowhere else.
